objective_pt: Reclamar de um produto ou serviço com educação, explicar o problema ("It doesn't work", "It's been broken since...") e pedir uma solução (reembolso, troca, conserto).

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer falando de problemas do dia a dia.
prompts: Have you ever had a problem with something you bought online?
watchFor: Dizer "I want to complain about of"; é "complain about".
Usar tom direto demais ("I want my money"); mostre "I'd like a refund, please".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita a frase educada para começar uma reclamação.
exercises.prompt: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order.
accepted: Excuse me, I'm afraid there's a problem with my order
Excuse me, I'm afraid there is a problem with my order
Excuse me, I am afraid there is a problem with my order

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça o atendente e diga que o seu celular não liga.
exercises.listen: Hi, how can I help you today?
accepted: My phone won't turn on
My phone doesn't turn on
My phone isn't turning on
Hi, my phone won't turn on
Hi, my phone doesn't turn on
My phone won't switch on
My phone doesn't switch on
Hi, I have a problem. My phone won't turn on

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A negação no presente precisa de "doesn't" (ou "won't", para algo que se recusa a funcionar): "My phone won't turn on".
"Ligar" um aparelho é "turn on" ou "switch on". "Connect" é conectar e "call" é ligar para alguém.

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual é a forma mais educada de pedir o dinheiro de volta?
exercises.explanation_pt: "I'd like a refund, please" é firme e educado. As outras soam agressivas em inglês.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender palavras para descrever defeitos e pedir soluções.
prompts: What's the difference between a refund and an exchange?
Have you ever asked for a refund?
watchFor: Usar "devolution" para devolução; o certo é "return".

exercises.example_en: Can I get a full refund?
The charger you sold me is faulty.
I'd like to return these shoes.
Can you sort this out for me, please?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu gostaria de devolver esta camisa."
accepted: I'd like to return this shirt
I would like to return this shirt
I want to return this shirt
I'd like to return this shirt, please
Could I return this shirt
Can I return this shirt

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Devolver um produto na loja é "return". "Devolve" não tem esse sentido em inglês.
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd like to return this shirt.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "would like" vem "to" + verbo: "I'd like to return".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd like to return this shirt.

teacher.goal_pt: Usar a entonação para soar educado e não agressivo, e pronunciar "receipt" (o "p" é mudo).
prompts: Say "receipt". Do you hear a P?
Say "I'm afraid it doesn't work" politely.
watchFor: Pronunciar o "p" de "receipt"; o som é "ri-SÍT".
Falar com entonação reta e seca; suba levemente no fim dos pedidos.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "p" de "receipt" não é pronunciado.
accepted: Here's the receipt
Here is the receipt

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita com tom gentil, subindo levemente no final.
exercises.prompt: I was wondering if you could help me with this.
accepted: I was wondering if you could help me with this
I was wondering if you could help me

teacher.goal_pt: Entender o atendente e responder com informações do problema.
prompts: What exactly is wrong with it?
watchFor: Responder "I bought it in last week"; é "last week", sem preposição.
Dizer "It's broken since Monday" em vez de "It's been broken since Monday".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha a solução oferecida.
exercises.listen: I'm sorry about that. We can't give you a refund, but we can exchange it for a new one.
exercises.explanation_pt: "We can't give you a refund" = não podem reembolsar; "we can exchange it for a new one" = podem trocar por um novo.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que comprou na semana passada.
accepted: I bought it last week
Last week
I got it last week
It was last week
I bought it here last week
I bought it last week, on Friday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Last week" não leva preposição: "I bought it last week".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que a tela está quebrada desde segunda-feira.
exercises.listen: What seems to be the problem?
accepted: The screen has been broken since Monday
The screen's been broken since Monday
The screen is broken. It's been like that since Monday
The screen has been cracked since Monday
The screen stopped working on Monday
The screen broke on Monday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Está quebrada desde segunda" usa present perfect em inglês: "has been broken since Monday".
commonErrors.correction_en: The screen has been broken since Monday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Se a tela continua quebrada, use "has been" com "since": "The screen has been broken since Monday".
commonErrors.correction_en: The screen has been broken since Monday.

teacher.goal_pt: Fazer uma reclamação completa: cumprimentar, explicar o problema, dar detalhes e pedir uma solução.
prompts: Tell me about a bad experience at a restaurant or hotel.
What would you say to the manager?
watchFor: Usar "I want to talk with the responsible"; o natural é "Could I speak to the manager?".
Esquecer de dizer o que você quer como solução.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu poderia falar com o gerente, por favor?"
accepted: Could I speak to the manager, please
Could I speak with the manager, please
Can I speak to the manager, please
Can I talk to the manager, please
May I speak to the manager, please
Could I talk to the manager, please
Could I speak to the manager

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "O responsável" não vira "the responsible". Peça "the manager" ou "the person in charge".
commonErrors.correction_en: Could I speak to the manager, please?
Could I speak to the manager, please?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu estou esperando há quarenta minutos."
accepted: I've been waiting for forty minutes
I have been waiting for forty minutes
I've been waiting for 40 minutes
I've been waiting forty minutes
I have been waiting forty minutes
We've been waiting for forty minutes

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ação que começou no passado e continua usa o present perfect continuous: "I've been waiting for forty minutes".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've been waiting for forty minutes.
I've been waiting for forty minutes.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: This is not what I ordered.

exercises.instruction_pt: Faça uma reclamação sobre um produto com defeito.
exercises.prompt_en: You bought headphones online and one side doesn't work. Call the store and explain the problem.
guidelines_pt: Comece com educação: "Hi, I'm calling about an order...".
Explique o problema e desde quando: "The left side has stopped working...".
Peça uma solução clara: "I'd like a refund" ou "Could you send me a new pair?".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar "refund / return / exchange" e a estrutura "has been ... since".
prompts: What would you say if your food arrived cold?
How do you ask for a refund?

exercises.prompt: I'm afraid this isn't good enough.
accepted: I'm afraid this isn't good enough
I am afraid this is not good enough
I'm afraid this is not good enough

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "A comida chegou fria."
accepted: The food arrived cold
The food came cold
The food was cold when it arrived
My food arrived cold
The food is cold

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Não há preposição aqui: "The food arrived cold".

exercises.instruction_pt: Como se diz "devolução" de um produto?
exercises.explanation_pt: Devolução é "return". "Devolution" é um termo político (transferência de poder).

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete com a forma certa de "be".
exercises.sentence: The washing machine has ___ broken since Monday.
accepted: been

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "has" vem o particípio: "has been".
commonErrors.correction_en: The washing machine has been broken since Monday.
